component: Folder picker hierarchy and local array ownership

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When enumerating a server parent, the picker replaces the first matching Gmail grouping-folder entry with that entry’s children and then applies its normal filters. The native IMAP getter delegates to a base getter that copies references into the output array. This is a presentation-array transformation; it does not alter the native folder hierarchy. The menu tests compare labels/structure across configured modes, while recent/favorite destination population remains TODO coverage.
title: Folder picker construction flattens one Gmail grouping node before filtering
